2	
3	## Goal / HARD RULE
4	DONE only when fresh `FORCE_CUDA=1 ./build.sh` → `wiring_check.py` shows
5	`path=L3-TC-megakernel(wgmma)` for the cell AND `test_l3tc_tail_gate` A/A/A

8	## Eager LookSAM semantics (the parity target)
9	- train loop: fwd+bwd at p → g (reduced grad). Then:
10	  - `should_sam_step()` == (`_global_step % k == 0`); `_global_step` starts 0,
11	    increments inside `step()`. So SAM FIRES at step 1 (0%5==0), and every k.
12	  - `sam_step`: GLOBAL grad norm `‖g‖` over ALL tensors (compute_sam_grad_norm_
13	    device_side); `rho_over_norm = rho/‖g‖`; perturb `p' = p + rho_over_norm·g`
14	    (backup = p.clone()); 2nd fwd+bwd at p' → g_sam; restore p; `sam_dir = g_sam - g`
15	    (PERSISTED state). p.grad restored to g.
16	  - `step()` (EVERY step): `g_adj = (1-alpha)·g + alpha·sam_dir`; AdamW on g_adj.
17	- Intervening steps: reuse cached sam_dir (no 2nd backward).
18	
19	## In-kernel design (decoder TC kernel; same shape vit/mamba)
20	Insert between B2 (reduced grad g ready) and P3, guarded `if constexpr (Opt==LookSAM)`:
21	- sam_dir lives in the persistent `extra` state slice (state[2*total:3*total]) ==
22	  st.sam_dir buffer, total floats, persists across steps. Standard 3*total+1 state.
23	- NEW transient workspace (carved LAST, unconditional, like muon scratch):
24	  - `sam_backup` [total]   — param backup for exact restore
25	  - `sam_grad`   [total]   — g_sam (2nd-backward reduced grad), must NOT clobber g
26	- Host passes `looksam_is_sam_step` (1.0/0.0) + `rho` + `alpha` via FusedScalars.
27	- ON SAM step (st.looksam_sam == 1):
28	  1. global ‖g‖ via the deterministic P2.5-style ascending reduce → rho_over_norm.
29	  2. backup p, perturb p += rho_over_norm·g (per-element, P3-style grid stride).
30	  3. bar.sync; re-run P1' fwd+bwd at perturbed p into acts (reusable) → write g_sam
31	     partials, then re-run P2' grad assembly into `sam_grad` (NOT grad).
32	  4. bar.sync; sam_dir = sam_grad - grad (per element); restore p = sam_backup.
33	  5. bar.sync.
34	- ON non-SAM step: sam_dir already holds the cached direction (state carried). No-op.
35	- P3: apply_optimizer<LookSAM> reads st.sam_dir (already wired in opt_components),
36	  g_adj=(1-alpha)g+alpha·sam_dir, AdamW. UNCHANGED.
37

39	- dectc_forward_tile / dectc_backward_tile are pure device fns (all state via args:
40	  weights w=dec_bind(params), acts, scratch, smem). Re-running at perturbed params
41	  into the same acts/scratch is structurally fine (acts free after P2 grad assembly).
42	- P2 grad-assembly (dW specs, biases, embed scan, lnvec reduce) writes to a grad ptr.
43	  For the 2nd pass I point it at `sam_grad`.
44

46	- dispatch.cpp wgmma_tail_opt_id: add `looksam → 4`.
47	- dispatch.cpp: thread looksam scalars (rho, alpha already via FusedScalars.alpha,
48	  sam_step flag) + bind sam workspace; bump TC workspace size for the 2 extra
49	  total-sized regions.
50	- _opt_scalars_from: add looksam branch (alpha=group['alpha'], looksam_rho, and the
51	  SAM-step flag computed from optimizer._global_step % k).
52	- fused_train_step: forward the looksam extra scalars.
53	- dispatch.py: add (decoder,looksam) etc to _FUSED_L3_REAL + _L3_WGMMA_CELLS;
54	  gemm_impl_for_cell already keys off _L3_WGMMA_CELLS.
55	- train_looksam: call _try_fused_train_step (keep eager sam_step prefix? NO — the L3
56	  kernel does the SAM 2nd backward in-kernel; on a fused hit skip eager sam_step+step).
57	  BUT _global_step cadence must still advance so should_sam_step phase matches; the
58	  host computes the flag from opt._global_step BEFORE the launch and increments after.
59

61	The gate injects kernel grad into p.grad and runs opt_ref.step() — but LookSAM.step()
62	blends with sam_dir which is ZERO unless sam_step ran. So the looksam factory/gate

2	
3	Owner requirement (2026-06-09): every (model × optimizer × arch) configuration —
4	all 3 models × 11 optimizers — composes into ONE persistent megakernel binary,
5	and the building blocks are **individually portable**: a third project lifts the
6	headers and instantiates a fused trainer without dragging this repo along. The
7	meta-programming lives in headers; the dispatch layer is generated and is the
8	only composition seam.
9

11	
12	| component | header(s) | contract |
13	|---|---|---|
14	| **Substrate** | `csrc/fused/megakernel_common.cuh` | `PersistentContext` (task counter, grid barrier, generation), one-CTA-per-SM persistent launch idiom. Depends on CUDA runtime only. |
15	| **Optimizer math** | `csrc/algorithms/<opt>.h` (×11) | Pure per-element apply math (`<opt>_step(...)`), no CUDA dependencies beyond `__device__` qualifiers, no state allocation, no I/O. 16	| **Optimizer tails** | `csrc/fused/sm_90/opt_components.cuh` | `apply_optimizer<OptId>(FusedOptState&, FusedScalars const&, ...)` — templates composing the algorithm headers into megakernel stages. Consumes the documented POD structs only. |

1	// csrc/fused/sm_90/sg2_meta_tail.cu — host-launcher TU for the SuperGrok2 FULL
2	// CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU meta-net persistent megakernel (csrc/fused/sm_90/
3	// opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh). This is the INTEGRATION seam specified in
4	// INTEGRATION-NOTES.md §1: the §1b host wrapper body lives HERE (a .cu TU that
5	// nvcc compiles, so the `kernel<<<...>>>` launch + the device-templated
6	// `launch_sg2_meta_optimizer_tail<Dims,...>` are legal), while bindings.cpp
7	// (host-only .cpp) extern-declares + PYBIND11-registers the two entry points
8	// (it cannot #include the .cuh: host gcc cannot parse the launch syntax).
9	//
10	// TWO non-template host entry points, both with a plain torch::Tensor / scalar
11	// boundary (the same boundary every existing SG2 launcher uses):
12	//   sg::sg2_meta_optimizer_tail(...)  — marshals the packed buffers + meta
13	//       bundle + scalars into SG2Weights/SG2State/SG2Scalars/PersistentContext
14	//       and launches the persistent megakernel (the launch-elimination of
15	//       csa_hca_step_one's ~15-20 per-tensor launches).
16	//   sg::sg2_ws_stride(int64_t Nmax) -> int64_t  — exposes the AUTHORITATIVE
17	//       per-CTA workspace stride sg::fused::sm90::sg2_ws_stride<SG2Dims<>>(Nmax)
18	//       so the Python driver's host stride can never drift from the kernel's
19	//       carve (INTEGRATION-NOTES.md §2 "Strongly prefer binding ... directly").
20	//
21	// SETUP.PY: this TU is globbed into _ops by `csrc/fused/sm_90/*.cu` and owns NO
22	// PYBIND11_MODULE — so it is NOT dropped by setup.py's content-based filter
23	// (which removes only standalone-JIT cell drivers that define their own module)
24	// and does NOT collide on PyInit__ops. No glob edit needed.
25	//
26	// PRECISION / PARITY: fp32 throughout (matches csa_hca_step_one's fp32 compute
27	// and the parity-validated apply). Bit-faithful to the per-op math up to fp32
28	// reduction-order round-off in the hand-written GRU/PEER dots (the documented
29	// 1e-5 parity hotspots — see the .cuh header). NOT bit-identity.
30	
31	#include <cuda_runtime.h>
32	#include <cstdint>
33	
34	#include <torch/extension.h>
35	#include <ATen/cuda/CUDAContext.h>
36	#include <c10/cuda/CUDAStream.h>
37	
38	#include "csrc/fused/sm_90/opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh"
39	
40	namespace sg {
41	
42	// Compile-time dims = supergrok2.py constructor defaults + OPTIMIZER_CONFIGS
43	// ["supergrok2"] (d_model=8, num_heads=2, gru_hidden=4, num_experts=144, ...).
44	// The race uses these defaults; a config with different shapes would template-
45	// specialize the launcher (compile-time dims). Mirrored in the Python driver +
46	// sg2_ws_stride below so the host packing/stride and the kernel carve agree.
47	using SG2DimsDefault = ::sg::fused::sm90::SG2Dims<>;
48	
49	// ── sg2_ws_stride: the AUTHORITATIVE floats-per-CTA workspace stride. The
50	//    Python driver calls this (not a duplicated py formula) so the host
51	//    allocation and the kernel's sg2_carve_ws can never drift. ───────────────
52	int64_t sg2_ws_stride(int64_t Nmax) {
53	    return ::sg::fused::sm90::sg2_ws_stride<SG2DimsDefault>(Nmax);
54	}
55	
56	// ── sg2_meta_optimizer_tail: the §1b host wrapper. Marshals the packed flat
57	//    buffers, the (fp32) meta weight bundle, the per-tensor + shared scalars,
58	//    and the persistent-context scratch into the POD structs, then launches the
59	//    ONE persistent kernel that runs CSA/HCA/GRU/PEER/apply for ALL tensors.
60	//    The argsort (perm/unsort) is PRE-COMPUTED by the driver (the one explicit
61	//    pre-kernel step — honesty rail #5). ──────────────────────────────────────
62	void sg2_meta_optimizer_tail(
63	    torch::Tensor params_packed,       // [total]   float32, all tensors back-to-back
64	    torch::Tensor grads_packed,        // [total]   float32
65	    torch::Tensor sharpness_packed,    // [total]   float32
66	    torch::Tensor exp_avg_packed,      // [total]   float32  (Adam m)
67	    torch::Tensor exp_avg_sq_packed,   // [total]   float32  (Adam v)
68	    torch::Tensor mu_packed,           // [total]   float32  (expert-output EMA)
69	    torch::Tensor slow_packed,         // [total]   float32  (grokfast slow EMA)
70	    torch::Tensor gru_state_packed,    // [total*gru_hidden] float32, row-major
71	    torch::Tensor perm_packed,         // [total]   int32  sorted-row -> original-row
72	    torch::Tensor unsort_packed,       // [total]   int32  original-row -> sorted-row
73	    torch::Tensor n_per_tensor,        // [P]       int32  element count of each tensor
74	    torch::Tensor row_off,             // [P]       int64  start element of each tensor
75	    torch::Tensor workspace,           // [n_ctas * ws_stride] float32 (kernel scratch)
76	    int64_t ws_stride,                 // floats per CTA (== sg2_ws_stride(Nmax))
77	    // ── meta weight bundle (fp32; upcast once by the driver) ──
78	    torch::Tensor input_proj_W, torch::Tensor input_proj_b,
79	    torch::Tensor csa_q_W, torch::Tensor csa_k_W, torch::Tensor csa_v_W, torch::Tensor csa_out_W,
80	    torch::Tensor csa_compress_w, torch::Tensor csa_idx_DQ, torch::Tensor csa_idx_K,
81	    torch::Tensor hca_q_W, torch::Tensor hca_k_W, torch::Tensor hca_v_W, torch::Tensor hca_out_W,
82	    torch::Tensor gru_Wz, torch::Tensor gru_bz, torch::Tensor gru_Wr, torch::Tensor gru_br,
83	    torch::Tensor gru_Wh, torch::Tensor gru_bh,
84	    torch::Tensor peer_query_Ws, torch::Tensor prod_keys_A, torch::Tensor prod_keys_B,
85	    torch::Tensor expert_W1, torch::Tensor expert_b1, torch::Tensor expert_W2, torch::Tensor expert_b2,
86	    // ── per-tensor scalars (length P) + shared scalars ──
87	    torch::Tensor alpha,        // [P] float  mu/slow mixing + slow-EMA decay (alpha_i)
88	    torch::Tensor gru_decay,    // [P] float  expert-EMA (mu) decay (== beta1_i)
89	    torch::Tensor lamb_eff,     // [P] float  grokfast amplification (lamb·ramp·gate)
90	    torch::Tensor beta1,        // [P] float  Adam beta1 (layer-scaled)
91	    torch::Tensor bc1,          // [P] float  1 - beta1_i^t
92	    torch::Tensor bc2,          // [P] float  1 - beta2^t
93	    double rescale,             // expert-output scale (shared)
94	    double beta2,               // shared
95	    double lr,                  // shared
96	    double wd,                  // shared  decoupled weight decay (wd_eff)
97	    double eps,                 // shared
98	    // ── persistent-context scratch (host-allocated, zero-init each launch) ──
99	    torch::Tensor g_next_task,  // int32   [1]  TaskQueue counter
100	    torch::Tensor g_arrived,    // int32   [1]  GridBarrier arrival count (reused as unsigned)
101	    torch::Tensor g_generation) // int32   [1]  GridBarrier generation (reused as unsigned)
102	{
103	    using namespace ::sg::fused::sm90;
104	    if (params_packed.numel() == 0) return;
105	    TORCH_CHECK(params_packed.scalar_type() == at::kFloat,
106	                "sg2_meta_optimizer_tail: fp32 packed buffers in this pass");
107	    TORCH_CHECK(perm_packed.scalar_type() == at::kInt &&
108	                unsort_packed.scalar_type() == at::kInt,
109	                "sg2_meta_optimizer_tail: perm/unsort must be int32");
110	    TORCH_CHECK(row_off.scalar_type() == at::kLong,
111	                "sg2_meta_optimizer_tail: row_off must be int64");
112	    TORCH_CHECK(n_per_tensor.scalar_type() == at::kInt,
113	                "sg2_meta_optimizer_tail: n_per_tensor must be int32");
114	
115	    auto stream = at::cuda::getCurrentCUDAStream().stream();
116	    const int P = (int)n_per_tensor.numel();
117	
118	    SG2Weights w {
119	        input_proj_W.data_ptr<float>(), input_proj_b.data_ptr<float>(),
120	        csa_q_W.data_ptr<float>(), csa_k_W.data_ptr<float>(), csa_v_W.data_ptr<float>(),
121	        csa_out_W.data_ptr<float>(), csa_compress_w.data_ptr<float>(),
122	        csa_idx_DQ.data_ptr<float>(), csa_idx_K.data_ptr<float>(),
123	        hca_q_W.data_ptr<float>(), hca_k_W.data_ptr<float>(), hca_v_W.data_ptr<float>(),
124	        hca_out_W.data_ptr<float>(),
125	        gru_Wz.data_ptr<float>(), gru_bz.data_ptr<float>(),
126	        gru_Wr.data_ptr<float>(), gru_br.data_ptr<float>(),
127	        gru_Wh.data_ptr<float>(), gru_bh.data_ptr<float>(),
128	        peer_query_Ws.data_ptr<float>(), prod_keys_A.data_ptr<float>(),
129	        prod_keys_B.data_ptr<float>(),
130	        expert_W1.data_ptr<float>(), expert_b1.data_ptr<float>(),
131	        expert_W2.data_ptr<float>(), expert_b2.data_ptr<float>() };
132	
133	    SG2State st {
134	        exp_avg_packed.data_ptr<float>(), exp_avg_sq_packed.data_ptr<float>(),
135	        mu_packed.data_ptr<float>(), slow_packed.data_ptr<float>(),
136	        gru_state_packed.data_ptr<float>(),
137	        perm_packed.data_ptr<int>(), unsort_packed.data_ptr<int>(),
138	        workspace.data_ptr<float>(), (int64_t)ws_stride, P,
139	        n_per_tensor.data_ptr<int>(), row_off.data_ptr<int64_t>() };
140	
141	    SG2Scalars sc {
142	        alpha.data_ptr<float>(), gru_decay.data_ptr<float>(), lamb_eff.data_ptr<float>(),
143	        beta1.data_ptr<float>(), bc1.data_ptr<float>(), bc2.data_ptr<float>(),
144	        (float)rescale, (float)beta2, (float)lr, (float)wd, (float)eps };
145	
146	    ::sg::fused::PersistentContext ctx {};  // PersistentContext lives in sg::fused (parent of sm90)
147	    ctx.g_next_task  = g_next_task.data_ptr<int>();
148	    ctx.g_arrived    = reinterpret_cast<unsigned*>(g_arrived.data_ptr<int>());     // int32 buffer reused
149	    ctx.g_generation = reinterpret_cast<unsigned*>(g_generation.data_ptr<int>());
150	    ctx.n_tasks      = P;
151	    // n_ctas is set inside the launcher (== #SMs).
152	
153	    // NOTE: bind to a temporary FIRST. The template arg list's commas would
154	    // otherwise be parsed by the preprocessor as extra C10_CUDA_CHECK macro
155	    // arguments ("passed 3 arguments, but takes just 1").
156	    cudaError_t launch_err =
157	        launch_sg2_meta_optimizer_tail<SG2DimsDefault, float, float>(
158	            ctx, w, st, sc,
159	            params_packed.data_ptr<float>(), grads_packed.data_ptr<float>(),
160	            sharpness_packed.data_ptr<float>(), stream);
161	    C10_CUDA_CHECK(launch_err);
162	}
163	
164	}  // namespace sg
